raw_definitions: Definisi : vi berolak: the water eddied around the rocks, air berolak di keliling batu-batu itu. (Kamus Inggeris-Melayu Dewan)

Definisi : n olak(an) (+ approp n ): the boat drifted downstream until it was caught in an ~, perahu itu hanyut ke hilir sehingga terperangkap dlm olakan air; eddies of smoke rose from the chimneys, olakan asap keluar dr serombong-serombong itu; (Kamus Inggeris-Melayu Dewan)
